questions.stem: It's really cold in this classroom.

options.A: The class is about cold-weather animals.
options.B: I'll wear shorts to class tomorrow.
options.C: Should I ask the professor to adjust the heat?

questions.explanation: Offering to ask about the heat responds helpfully to a complaint; the 'Yes' option contradicts it.
